about_the_game:
Museum Guard: Exhibit Unknown is a short, atmospheric horror game where you take on the role of a lone night guard in a long-forgotten museum. But the artifacts aren’t the only things left behind…

While completing tasks, explore dark corridors, uncover hidden rooms, and restore lost memories as the museum begins to change around you. Armed only with your flashlight and your instincts, you must survive the night with an exhibit that was never meant to be found.

Key Features:

  • For fans of Order 13, The Mortuary Assistant, and Phasmophobia.

  • Patrol the museum after hours… until the exhibits start moving on their own.

  • Access areas in any order, but unlocking keys and tools will reveal deeper secrets—and danger.

  • Your mind is your greatest weapon—and your greatest enemy. Restoring sanity may help… or hurt.

  • Investigate strange characters, shifting environments, and exhibits that seem to watch you back.

  • Your decisions matter. Will you uncover the full story or be trapped forever in the dark?

content_descriptors.notes: Museum Guard: Exhibit Unknown has cigarettes and alcohol to restore sanity. Also, it can include terrifying moments.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or Windows 11
  • Processor: Ryzen 3 2200G / Intel i5-7400
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD RX 570 / Nvidia GTX 1060
  • DirectX: Version 11

pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or Windows 11
  • Processor: Ryzen 7 2700X / Intel i7-9700K
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD RX 5070 / Nvidia 2060
